decision.reason: [ev-be13d23a0cf1] is only a one-line changelog commit title. It says that semver constraint matching is now checked in the application webhook handler. It does not say what the old behavior was or what the new behavior is. It also does not say which configurations are exposed (for example, which targetRevision constraint forms or webhook providers), or what an operator who does nothing would experience. To write the typed assertion, the PR description or diff (#21648/#22507) is needed.
